name: XLA_ONLINE_TXN_PROCS
description: This table represents the collection of processes running the online transaction engine.  Each row will map to a single concurrent request identifier which is the primary key to this table.

columns.name: CRID
columns.description: Primary key and concurrent request identifier for process.

columns.name: ENGINE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the engine that is running.

columns.name: ENGINE_LANGUAGE
columns.description: Implementation languages are [C], [J] Java, or [P] PL/SQL.

columns.name: SPECIALIZATION_ZONE
columns.description: Used to segregate requests for performance default 0 *.

columns.name: PROCESS_STATUS
columns.description: Process status value for online accounting processing.

columns.name: ERR_MSG
columns.description: Error message name for online accounting processing.

columns.name: TXN_COUNT
columns.description: Count of transaction by online accounting processing.

columns.name: PARENT_CRID
columns.description: Concurrent request identifier of process that this process is replacing.

columns.name: CHILD_CRID
columns.description: Concurrent request identifier of process that is replacing this process.

columns.name: OTE_CACHE_INVALIDATION_EVENTS
OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ESS_REQ_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the online engine request.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
